title: Admin & Procurement Executive
description:
We are conducting a **Walk\-in Interview on 23rd Septermber 2026**

Interested candidates are requested to **share their CV at the email ID below** to receive details regarding the **interview venue, timing, and other relevant information**.

**Email:** \- shounli@rebrace.co.in  
**Candidates are requested to mention the position applied for in the subject line.**

We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Office Administration \& Procurement Executive to manage office administration while overseeing timely procurement activities related to the company's third\-party manufacturing operations. The incumbent will coordinate with contract manufacturing partners, vendors, and internal teams to ensure timely procurement and uninterrupted product availability across all company brands.

**Key ResponsibilitiesOffice Administration**

* Manage the day\-to\-day administration of the corporate office.
* Oversee housekeeping, facility management, office maintenance, and office assets.
* Procure office stationery, pantry items, furniture, equipment, and other administrative requirements.
* Coordinate courier services, travel arrangements, and vendor services.
* Maintain office records, agreements, utility bills, and annual maintenance contracts.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, and other departments for administrative support.

**Procurement \& Third\-Party Manufacturing**

* Plan and execute procurement activities for all company brands manufactured through third\-party manufacturing partners.
* Coordinate with contract manufacturers to ensure timely production, dispatch, and availability of finished goods.
* Raise Purchase Orders (POs) and monitor their execution.
* Follow up with manufacturing partners regarding production schedules, batch planning, and dispatch timelines.
* Coordinate procurement of packaging materials, printed components, promotional materials, and other production\-related requirements.
* Track inventory levels and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Warehouse, and Finance to forecast procurement requirements and prevent stock shortages.
* Identify and onboard new third\-party manufacturers and vendors as required.
* Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, and delivery schedules with vendors and manufacturing partners.
* Maintain procurement records, production schedules, vendor databases, agreements, quotations, and purchase documentation.
* Coordinate invoice verification and payment follow\-up with the Finance department.
* Monitor vendor performance with respect to quality, compliance, cost, and on\-time delivery.
* Ensure uninterrupted product availability by proactively planning procurement based on sales forecasts and business requirements.
* Coordinate with Regulatory, Quality Assurance, and manufacturing partners for timely documentation and compliance wherever applicable.

**Eligibility**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Pharmacy, or a related field.
* Minimum 6 months of experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Purchase, or Third\-Party Manufacturing Coordination.
* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry is mandatory.
* Working knowledge of third\-party manufacturing, production planning, procurement processes, and inventory management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems.

**Key Skills**

* Third\-party manufacturing coordination
* Pharmaceutical procurement
* Vendor development and management
* Production planning and follow\-up
* Inventory and supply planning
* Commercial negotiation
* Documentation and compliance
* Strong communication and coordination skills
* Problem\-solving and multitasking

**Fresher's Eligible**  
**Office Location\- Akankha**

**Salary will be commensurate with qualifications, experience, and industry standards.**

Pay: ₹10,029\.00 \- ₹25,537\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Administrative: 1 year (Required)
* Procurement management: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
